fixes.explanation: Temple? Friend, I love a good guess, but the temple never shows up in this verse. Jesus says to go, sell everything he owns, and give to the poor. Then comes the part that gets me: he'll have treasure in heaven, and after that he's invited to come follow Jesus (Mark 10:21). That's a lot of stuff to sell, and I can barely decide which cookie to eat first.

Priests? Ooh, I see where your mind went, friend, but no priest is in this verse at all. Jesus tells the man to sell everything he owns and give to the poor. In the very same breath He promises treasure in heaven, and then says, "Then come, follow Me." (Mark 10:21) That's the invitation I'd frame on my bakery wall, right next to my favorite apron.
